response.sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) as rep_count FROM Customer c INNER JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), with_city_avg AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, rep_count, AVG(rep_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) as city_avg FROM rep_counts), total_matched AS (SELECT SUM(rep_count) as total_matched FROM rep_counts), filtered_reps AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, rep_count, city_avg FROM with_city_avg WHERE rep_count > city_avg) SELECT fr.City, SUM(fr.rep_count) as total_customers_kept_reps, AVG(fr.rep_count - fr.city_avg) as avg_excess_over_city_avg, AVG(fr.rep_count / tm.total_matched) as avg_share FROM filtered_reps fr CROSS JOIN total_matched tm GROUP BY fr.City
